verdicts_vs_registered_predictions.F1: FAILS (predicted >=20/24 certify): only 6/24 oracle units certify at R2>=0.8 (5 of them on h2, exactly where D3's five certified coordinates were); unit best-R2 mean 0.738. The gate is NOT exonerated: its R2 bar is unreachable on this model even for perfectly known truth. Attribution: the two-level class coder is near-perfect on clean identity-path spectra (R2 mean 0.996, 24/24) and the best class names the right unit 24/24 times even on oracle coordinates -- the failure is the per-head write-coordinate spectrum construction (24 orthonormal units compressed through a 16-dim per-head value space must leak into each other), not the coder and not upstream CP noise.
verdicts_vs_registered_predictions.F2: FAILS (predicted symmetric scoring erases the reversal): semi stays at exactly 16/24 under BOTH symmetric treatments -- (a) projection onto the 24-dim unit span (mean cosine 0.9029 -> 0.9050, so semi components are already almost entirely in-span, refuting the isotropic-junk account) and (b) an identically-fit ridge map (16/24, mean 0.9020) -- while learned reproduces 21/24 (mean 0.9432). The D2 reversal SURVIVES symmetric treatment: the learned arm genuinely recovers better.
verdicts_vs_registered_predictions.F3: FAILS in the informative direction (predicted the seed distribution spans the bar): NO seed passes 0.8 -- raw fracs 0.667 (original), 0.375, 0.125, 0.542, 0.542; mean cosines 0.903, 0.875, 0.854, 0.897, 0.898; all task gates pass at +0.0024..+0.0028 nats. The original 16/24 was the BEST of five seeds; D1's FAIL is seed-stable and the point estimate was flattering.
verdicts_vs_registered_predictions.F4: FAILS in the opposite direction (predicted 1.27 within 2 SE of 1.0): with sequence-clustered jackknife SEs the selection-vs-PCA privilege on the load-bearing head h2 is resolvable at EVERY dose k=1..4 (1.32+-0.06, 1.27+-0.03, 1.35+-0.04, 1.19+-0.03 -- all >2 SE above 1.0); vs energy-matched shrink the ratio brackets 1.0 (0.89, 0.95 below; 1.06, 1.03 above). h6 and h1 dose cells are degenerate (selection-contrast directions carry <0.2% of those heads' pattern energy). Overlap confirmation: the planted class-contrast top-2 directions carry 2.9e-5 of the pattern energy in the overlap model's load-bearing head h5 -- confirmed ~0%.
